rollout.question: How long does it take to roll out the platform?
rollout.answer: Initial setup takes only a few minutes. Small teams usually start the same day, while larger operations receive support migrating projects and documents.

migration.question: Can I migrate data from the tools I already use?
migration.answer: Yes. You can import projects, tasks, documents, and history from common tools while preserving owners, due dates, and attachments.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: Billing is monthly per active user, with a discount on annual plans. There is no setup fee, and you can change plans at any time.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with project-level permissions, audit logs, and daily backups.

mobile.question: Does the platform work on mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes. Tasks, conversations, documents, and notifications are available in mobile browsers and apps with real-time synchronization.

support.question: Is support available in English?
support.answer: Yes. Our own team provides support through in-app chat and email.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Policy explains which personal data Teron processes, why it is processed, who it is shared with, and how you can exercise your rights. It follows Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018).

controller.title: 1. Who processes your data
controller.organizationPrefix: When you use the platform as a member of an organization, that organization decides what goes into documents, tasks, and messages. In that case, it is the controller of that content and Teron acts as a
controller.organizationSuffix: , processing data according to its instructions.

collected.title: 2. Data we collect
collected.registrationDetails: : name, email, hashed password, profile picture, and organization.
collected.paymentDetails: : billing data required for the subscription. Card details are processed directly by the payment provider; we do not store the full card number.
collected.contentDetails: : what you create on the platform, including documents, tasks, messages, files, and recordings.
collected.supportDetails: : what you send us when requesting help.
collected.usageDetails: : pages and features accessed, actions performed, date, and time.
collected.technicalDetails: : IP address, device type, browser, operating system, and session identifiers.
collected.cookiesDetails: and similar technologies, as described in section 5.

purposes.title: 3. How we use data and our legal basis
purposes.platformDetails: — create your account, synchronize team work, make calls, and store your content.
purposes.contractBasis: Legal basis: performance of a contract.
purposes.billing: Process payments and issue tax documents
purposes.billingBasis: Legal basis: performance of a contract and legal obligation.
purposes.securityDetails: — prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access; maintain access records.
purposes.securityBasis: Legal basis: legal obligation under the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework and legitimate interest.
purposes.supportDetails: — respond to requests and communicate service changes.
purposes.improvementDetails: — understand feature usage on an aggregated basis.
purposes.marketingDetails: — news and content when you choose to receive them.
purposes.consentBasis: Legal basis: consent, which may be withdrawn at any time.
purposes.noSale: We do not sell personal data or use the content of your documents and messages for advertising.

sharing.title: 4. Who we share data with
sharing.providersDetails: — cloud hosting, payment processing, transactional email, usage analytics, and support. They process data only under our instructions and contractual terms.
sharing.organizationDetails: — workspace administrators can access account data and content created in the workspace.
sharing.authoritiesDetails: — when required by law, court order, or to defend a legal claim.
sharing.successorsDetails: — in a corporate reorganization, merger, or acquisition, subject to this Policy.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies
cookies.body: We use necessary cookies for sessions, authentication, and security. They cannot be disabled without affecting the platform. Analytics cookies depend on your consent and help us understand product usage. You can manage preferences in your browser.

security.title: 6. Security and storage
security.safeguards: We use technical and administrative safeguards, including encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest, permission-based access control, activity logs, and backups. The Business plan includes encrypted storage with no volume limit.
security.incidents: No system is completely immune. If a security incident creates material risk, we will notify you and Brazil's data protection authority within the legally required timeframes.

retention.title: 7. How long we retain data
retention.contentDetails: — while the account is active and for up to 30 days after closure to allow export.
retention.accessLogsDetails: — 6 months, as required by the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework.
retention.billingDetails: — 5 years, as required by applicable law.

rights.title: 8. Your rights
rights.body: The LGPD gives you the right to confirm processing, access and correct your data, request anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data, request portability, withdraw consent, and object to processing based on legitimate interest.
rights.contactPrefix: To exercise any of these rights, email
rights.contactSuffix: . We respond within 15 days. If you use Teron through an organization, we will forward the request when that organization is responsible for the processing.

transfers.title: 9. International transfers
transfers.body: Parts of our infrastructure may be outside Brazil. In those cases, transfers use safeguards required by the LGPD, including contractual clauses with providers and countries offering an adequate level of protection.

children.title: 10. Children and adolescents
children.body: The platform is not intended for anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If we identify such data, it will be deleted.

changes.title: 11. Changes to this Policy
changes.body: We may update this Policy. The latest revision date appears at the top, and material changes will be communicated by email or in the platform.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern use of Teron, the work platform that brings projects, tasks, documents, and communication together. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to these Terms.

about.title: 1. About us
about.companySuffix: , registered under CNPJ 38.486.051/0001-48. In this document, “Teron,” “we,” and “our” refer to that company, while “you” refers to anyone using the platform personally or for an organization.
about.authority: If you accept these Terms for a company, you represent that you have authority to bind it, and “you” means that company.

account.title: 2. Account
account.responsibility: To use the platform, you must create an account with accurate information and keep it current. You are responsible for protecting your credentials and for activity on your account.
account.age: You must be at least 18, or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction with authorization from a legal guardian.
account.unauthorizedUse: Notify us immediately of unauthorized use or suspected account compromise.
account.administrators: Organization accounts may have administrators who can manage, suspend, or remove team access.

billing.title: 3. Plans, billing, and cancellation
billing.intro: Available plans and their features are described on the
billing.free: — no charge, with unlimited users, basic storage, and unlimited video calls, limited to one month of use.
billing.business: — BRL 9.99 per user, including everything in Free plus unlimited encrypted storage.
billing.recurring: Billing is monthly and recurring at the start of each cycle, based on contracted workspace seats. Seats added during a cycle are charged immediately for the remaining prorated period; reductions take effect at the next renewal.
billing.cancellation: You may cancel at any time. Paid access continues through the current paid period and will not renew. Payments are non-refundable unless required by law, including Brazil's statutory seven-day withdrawal right.
billing.priceChanges: Prices may change. We will provide at least 30 days' notice, and changes apply only to future billing cycles.

acceptableUse.title: 4. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.intro: When using Teron, you agree not to:
acceptableUse.unlawful: violate the law or third-party rights, or publish unlawful, defamatory, or infringing content;
acceptableUse.malware: send malware, attempt unauthorized system access, or bypass technical and usage limits;
acceptableUse.spam: use the platform for spam or to overload infrastructure through automation;
acceptableUse.resale: resell, sublicense, or provide the service outside your workspace without written permission.

content.ownershipPrefix: Everything you create or upload, including documents, tasks, messages, and files, remains
content.ownershipSuffix: . We do not claim ownership of that content.
content.license: You grant us only the license needed to operate the service: storing, processing, transmitting, and displaying content to you and those you authorize, and making backups. This license ends when the content is deleted.
content.privacyPrefix: Personal data in that content is processed under our

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Our intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: The platform, code, brand, visual identity, and documentation belong to Teron or its licensors. These Terms grant a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use them, not a transfer of ownership.

availability.title: 7. Availability and service changes
availability.body: We work to keep the platform available, but scheduled maintenance and interruptions beyond our control may occur. Features may be added, changed, or discontinued. We will provide reasonable notice of material changes affecting your use.

termination.title: 8. Suspension and termination
termination.body: We may suspend or terminate access for violations of these Terms, nonpayment, or use that risks platform or user security. When reasonable, we will provide notice and an opportunity to correct the issue.
termination.exportSuffix: to export your content. After that period, data may be permanently deleted except where retention is required by law.

liability.title: 9. Warranties and liability
liability.warranty: The platform is provided as is. We do not warrant uninterrupted or error-free service or fitness for a specific purpose not agreed in writing.
liability.limitation: To the extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to the amount you paid in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim. We are not liable for lost profits or indirect damages. Nothing here limits non-waivable consumer rights.

changes.title: 10. Changes to these Terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms. Material changes will be communicated by email or in the platform at least 30 days in advance. Continued use after the effective date means you accept the new version.
